sketch:
Observe: SVG cart on a track; sliders for m and v; a large Eₖ = ½mv²
gauge fills in real time as the student changes either. No forces, no
work — pure formula visualization at 2S level. Experiment: reach a
target Eₖ by choosing m and v (multiple valid solutions surface the
trade-off). Evaluate: gauge hidden; given a target Eₖ, student picks
(m, v). Wrinkle: v² dependence is the pedagogical hook — doubling v
quadruples Eₖ.
